description:
Title: Inspection of an Energy Drink Bottling Machine

You develop an application that helps you with the inspection of a machine.
After entering the type of the machine, and its serial number, the inspection can begin:
* Questions are asked, and you have to input values.
* Buttons are to be pressed, and values are automatically collected from the machine and shown to you.
* Depending on the results, additional questions are asked (or not).
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/energy-drink-bottling-machine-inspection">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Inspection" name="Inspection of an Energy Drink Bottling Machine" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Inspection">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_User" name="User">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Inspection</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterMachineType</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterSerialNumber</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterInspectionValues</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PressInspectionButtons</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterAdditionalValues</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Inspection</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Application" name="Application">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PresentInspectionQuestions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CollectAndShowMachineValues</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ResultsCallForAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PresentAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MergeAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Inspection" name="Begin inspection"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterMachineType" name="Enter machine type"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterSerialNumber" name="Enter serial number"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_PresentInspectionQuestions" name="Present inspection questions"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterInspectionValues" name="Enter inspection values"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PressInspectionButtons" name="Press inspection buttons"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CollectAndShowMachineValues" name="Collect and show machine values"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ResultsCallForAdditionalQuestions" name="Do the results call for additional questions?" gatewayDirection="Diverging" default="Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_PresentAdditionalQuestions" name="Present additional questions"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterAdditionalValues" name="Enter additional values"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeAdditionalQuestions" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Inspection" name="Inspection complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToMachineType" sourceRef="Start_Inspection" targetRef="Task_EnterMachineType"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MachineTypeToSerialNumber" sourceRef="Task_EnterMachineType" targetRef="Task_EnterSerialNumber"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SerialNumberToQuestions" sourceRef="Task_EnterSerialNumber" targetRef="Task_PresentInspectionQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_QuestionsToValues" sourceRef="Task_PresentInspectionQuestions" targetRef="Task_EnterInspectionValues"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ValuesToButtons" sourceRef="Task_EnterInspectionValues" targetRef="Task_PressInspectionButtons"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ButtonsToCollection" sourceRef="Task_PressInspectionButtons" targetRef="Task_CollectAndShowMachineValues"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CollectionToDecision" sourceRef="Task_CollectAndShowMachineValues" targetRef="Gateway_ResultsCallForAdditionalQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalQuestionsRequired" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ResultsCallForAdditionalQuestions" targetRef="Task_PresentAdditionalQuestions">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>${resultsCallForAdditionalQuestions}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ResultsCallForAdditionalQuestions" targetRef="Gateway_MergeAdditionalQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PresentAdditionalToEnter" sourceRef="Task_PresentAdditionalQuestions" targetRef="Task_EnterAdditionalValues"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalValuesToMerge" sourceRef="Task_EnterAdditionalValues" targetRef="Gateway_MergeAdditionalQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToEnd" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeAdditionalQuestions" targetRef="End_Inspection"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
